summary: Pinal Airpark is a general aviation airport in Marana, Arizona, originally established as Marana Army Airfield during World War II for military pilot training. Today it is best known as a major aircraft storage and maintenance facility, hosting fleets of retired and temporarily parked commercial airliners from carriers worldwide. The airport features one of the longer runways in the region, capable of handling large narrow-body aircraft.
faqs:
Q: What is Pinal Airpark known for?
A: Pinal Airpark is primarily known as an aircraft storage and maintenance facility, hosting retired and temporarily parked commercial airliners, including many Boeing 737 Classics and other narrow-body jets.

Q: Where is Pinal Airpark located?
A: It is located in Marana, Arizona, approximately 40 miles northwest of Tucson in Pinal County
